newsitem.title: USA: Bayer says FDA expands CIPRO indications.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says FDA expands CIPRO indications.

text.p: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration cleared for market Bayer Corp's antibacterial CIPRO tablets for treatment of mild to moderate acute sinusitis, Bayer Corp said on Thursday.
Bayer Corp is a Bayer AG subsidiary.

Sinusitis is a bacterial infection of the mucous membranes lining the nasal sinus cavities. The FDA's approval refers to sinusitis caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae and Moraxella catarrhalis, which are becoming increasingly resistant to the antibiotics commonly given to treat acute sinusitis, Bayer said.
CIPRO is already indicated for a wide variety of infectious diseases, including lower respiratory infections and urinary tract infections, the company said.
